title: [Quality Management] Refactor permission management
summary: Quality Management now uses standard permission errors instead of custom table permission checks, simplifying permission management while maintaining administrator-only access controls.
key_points: Removed custom table permission validation logic from Quality Management objects
Relies on standard Business Central permission error handling instead
Preserves administrator-only capabilities through maintained access controls
Simplifies codebase with fewer permission-related checks
Fixes issue AB#625864 related to permission management
quote: Remove custom table permission checks and rely on standard permission errors while preserving administrator-only capabilities.
